selection: First DOI-sorted missing records: four APS, four Nature, two Elsevier, one PNAS, one Science Advances; additionally the sole Journal of Statistical Physics gap. Not a random sample.
stored_content: Metadata and paraphrased evidence only; no abstract, full text, HTML or PDF stored.

results.research_object: Data-driven approximation of the Koopman–von Neumann operator for ordinary differential equations.
results.methods: Projects a unitary operator into finite-dimensional bases, estimates spectral properties from data, and represents the matrix as a quantum circuit.
results.contribution: Develops numerical approximation methods and identifies domain and basis conditions using oscillator and Lotka–Volterra examples.
results.network_evidence: The abstract concerns classical dynamical-system operators; it does not establish a network-structure or dynamics-on-networks contribution.
results.caveat: Scope classification deferred; Accepted date is not publication date.

results.research_object: Passive adaptive mechanical networks built from directed springs.
results.methods: Uses stochastic external forces, direction-dependent spring stiffness, theoretical network analysis and an experimental elastic learning unit.
results.contribution: Shows how adaptation and network architecture can support stability and autonomous discovery of input patterns.
results.network_evidence: The abstract explicitly connects adaptive spring networks, architecture-dependent stability and learning dynamics.
results.caveat: Needs v9 boundary review for adaptive-material versus network-science main contribution; no final classification.

results.research_object: Magnetic particle aggregation in shear-thinning carrier fluids under external magnetic fields.
results.methods: Generalizes local drag-force theory and compares pairwise finite-element simulations, rotating-field predictions and magnetite experiments.
results.contribution: Explains larger and more ordered clusters in a power-law fluid and identifies aggregation as primarily dynamical.
results.network_evidence: Particle interactions and cluster formation are described without explicit network topology or network-science analysis in the abstract.
results.caveat: Do not equate particle clusters with networks; scope classification deferred.

results.research_object: Moving solids coupled to thermally convecting fluid, motivated by mantle convection and plate motion.
results.methods: Discusses laboratory experiments and mathematical models of thermal-blanket feedback, active-particle motion and fluctuations.
results.contribution: Synthesizes studies in which moving boundaries alter heat transport and flow patterns.
results.network_evidence: The abstract describes fluid-solid and heat-momentum coupling without an explicit network object or network-science method.
results.caveat: Perspective wording observed in abstract; formal type and v9 scope remain to be reviewed.

results.research_object: Infinite-dimensional Hamiltonian systems with short-range interactions and a fixed potential.
results.methods: The abstract states an existence proof of full-dimensional KAM tori; no proof technique is given.
results.contribution: Establishes abundance of full-dimensional invariant tori without treating the potential as an external parameter.
results.network_evidence: Short-range interactions are explicit; the one-sentence abstract does not establish network topology as a main contribution.
results.caveat: Complete publisher abstract is one sentence, unlike a truncated teaser. Scope may remain review. No full-text claims used; journal identity reused from original whitelist record.
